description: Expected structure and quality rules for daily transaction batches.

fields.name: device_id
fields.description: Identifier of the device used for the transaction.

fields.name: event_time
fields.description: Time at which the transaction occurred.

fields.name: ingestion_time
fields.description: Time at which the transaction entered the source system.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Transaction amount in the original currency.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO currency code of the transaction.

fields.name: transaction_country
fields.description: Country in which the transaction occurred.

fields.name: transaction_city
fields.description: City in which the transaction occurred.

fields.name: payment_method
fields.description: Payment method used for the transaction.

fields.name: is_refund
fields.description: Indicates whether the transaction represents a refund.

fields.name: is_late_arriving
fields.description: Indicates whether the event arrived late.

fields.name: device_trust_score
fields.description: Optional trust score introduced by schema drift from 2026-01-20 onward.

quality_rules.name: required_customer_id
quality_rules.description: customer_id must not be null or empty.

quality_rules.name: valid_currency
quality_rules.description: currency must contain an allowed ISO currency code.

quality_rules.name: valid_event_time
quality_rules.description: event_time must be convertible to a timestamp.

quality_rules.name: event_time_not_in_future
quality_rules.description: event_time must not be later than the batch processing date.

quality_rules.name: valid_purchase_amount
quality_rules.description: purchase transactions must have an amount greater than zero.

quality_rules.name: valid_refund_amount
quality_rules.description: refund transactions must have an amount below zero and is_refund must be true.

quality_rules.name: unique_transaction_id
quality_rules.description: Only the newest record for each transaction_id may remain in Silver.

quality_rules.name: valid_source_system
quality_rules.description: source_system must match an allowed normalized value.
